description: This file contains R functions for interacting with Apache Spark, including creating RDDs from files and collections, broadcasting variables, including packages on workers, setting checkpoint directories, and managing files in Spark. It is part of the SparkR package, specifically for context-driven functions related to SparkContext.

methods.name: getMinPartitions
methods.description: Calculates the minimum number of partitions for an RDD based on SparkContext's default parallelism.

methods.name: textFile
methods.description: Creates an RDD of strings from a text file located in HDFS, local filesystem, or Hadoop-supported URI.

methods.name: objectFile
methods.description: Loads an RDD saved as a SequenceFile containing serialized R objects.

methods.name: makeSplits
methods.description: Generates slice IDs for partitioning data evenly across serialized slices.

methods.name: parallelize
methods.description: Creates an RDD from a local R list or vector, splitting it into slices for distributed processing.

methods.name: getMaxAllocationLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum data size limit for serialized R objects in Spark.

methods.name: writeToConnection
methods.description: Writes serialized data slices to a connection, used for transferring data to Spark.

methods.name: writeToTempFile
methods.description: Serializes data slices and writes them to a temporary file for Spark processing.

methods.name: includePackage
methods.description: Includes an R package on all Spark worker nodes.

methods.name: broadcastRDD
methods.description: Broadcasts a read-only R object to all Spark workers for efficient reuse.

methods.name: setCheckpointDirSC
methods.description: Sets the checkpoint directory for Spark RDDs.

methods.name: spark.addFile
methods.description: Adds a file or directory to be downloaded on all Spark nodes.

methods.name: spark.getSparkFilesRootDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the root directory containing files added via spark.addFile.

methods.name: spark.getSparkFiles
methods.description: Gets the absolute path of a file added via spark.addFile.

methods.name: spark.lapply
methods.description: Distributes a function application over a list using Spark RDDs.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the logging level for Spark.

methods.name: setCheckpointDir
methods.description: Sets the checkpoint directory for Spark RDDs.
